title: Sideboard local snapshot
description: A producer-written JSON snapshot consumed by the generic Sideboard local_snapshot feature. Producers should write a temporary file and rename it atomically; consumers reject partial or invalid updates and keep the last good snapshot. Files are limited to 1 MiB and must be explicitly configured regular-file paths.

source_id.description: Producer's own stable identifier for this snapshot stream.

generated_at.description: When the producer generated the snapshot. ISO 8601 with a timezone offset; naive local timestamps are rejected.

expires_at.description: Optional producer validity horizon. A value in the past is allowed: the data is marked stale/expired and still shown.

privacy.description: Default private. Private snapshots are masked in privacy mode. Omit the key for the default; null is rejected.

metrics.description: Bounded list of scalar metrics. Unknown extra keys are rejected; null is rejected (omit the key instead).

label.description: Human label. No newlines or control characters.

value.description: Scalar value. Strings must not contain newlines or control characters; numbers must be finite.

unit.description: Unit of the value, for example s, GB, timestamp. Use "" when the value has no unit; null is rejected.

basis.description: How the value was obtained, for example measured, estimated, producer. Use "" when unknown; null is rejected.

history.description: Bounded, oldest-first numeric history for a sparkline. null entries are gaps and are preserved as gaps; the file supplies no per-sample timestamps.

items.description: Bounded short list with stable ids and optional HTTP(S) links. null is rejected (omit the key instead).

title.description: Item title. No newlines or control characters.

url.description: Optional absolute http(s) link. Other schemes are rejected.

published_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp with a timezone offset.
